questions.text: यदि दो धनात्मक पूर्णांकों a और b का महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) 1 है, तो उनका लघुतम समापवर्त्य (LCM) होगा :
questions.text_english: If the HCF of two positive integers a and b is 1, then their LCM is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) ab. When the HCF of two positive integers a and b is 1, the numbers are called co-prime. For any two positive integers, HCF × LCM = a × b. Since HCF = 1, we get LCM = ab. Options A, B, and C are incorrect because a+b, a alone, or b alone do not satisfy the fundamental relationship between HCF and LCM.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) ab है। जब दो धनात्मक पूर्णांकों a और b का HCF 1 होता है, तो वे सह-अभाज्य संख्याएँ कहलाती हैं। HCF × LCM = a × b के सूत्र से, HCF = 1 रखने पर LCM = ab प्राप्त होता है।

questions.text_english: The number 3 + √2 is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) an irrational number. Since √2 is irrational and 3 is rational, the sum of a rational and an irrational number is always irrational. Therefore 3 + √2 is irrational. It is not an integer or a natural number because it contains √2 which is non-terminating and non-repeating.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) अपरिमेय संख्या है। √2 अपरिमेय है और 3 परिमेय है। एक परिमेय और एक अपरिमेय संख्या का योग सदैव अपरिमेय होता है। अतः 3 + √2 अपरिमेय संख्या है।

questions.text: द्विघात समीकरण x² − 3x − 2 = 0 का विविक्तकर (discriminant) है :
questions.text_english: The discriminant of the quadratic equation x² − 3x − 2 = 0 is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) 17. For the quadratic equation x² − 3x − 2 = 0, we have a = 1, b = −3, c = −2. The discriminant D = b² − 4ac = (−3)² − 4(1)(−2) = 9 + 8 = 17. Options A, C, and D give incorrect values since √17 and −√17 are the actual roots, not the discriminant.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) 17 है। x² − 3x − 2 = 0 के लिए a=1, b=−3, c=−2। विविक्तकर D = b² − 4ac = 9 + 8 = 17।

questions.text: समीकरण x + 1/x = 3 (x ≠ 0) को एक द्विघात समीकरण ax² + bx + c = 0 के रूप में व्यक्त किया जाता है। a − b + c का मान है :
questions.text_english: The equation x + 1/x = 3 (x ≠ 0) is expressed as a quadratic equation in the form of ax² + bx + c = 0. The value of a − b + c is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) −1. Multiplying both sides of x + 1/x = 3 by x gives x² + 1 = 3x, which rearranges to x² − 3x + 1 = 0. So a = 1, b = −3, c = 1. Therefore a − b + c = 1 − (−3) + 1 = 1 + 3 + 1 = 5. Wait — rechecking: a − b + c = 1 − (−3) + 1 = 5. But evaluating at x = −1: (−1)² + 3 + 1 = 5 ≠ 0. The standard substitution is a − b + c means putting x = −1 into the polynomial: 1 + 3 + 1 = 5. However, using a=1, b=−3, c=1: a−b+c = 1−(−3)+1 = 5. The answer is (A) 5.
questions.solution_hindi: x + 1/x = 3 को x से गुणा करने पर x² − 3x + 1 = 0 प्राप्त होता है। a=1, b=−3, c=1। a − b + c = 1 − (−3) + 1 = 5। सही उत्तर (A) 5 है।

questions.text_english: For a point (3, −5), the value of (abscissa − ordinate) is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) 8. For a point (3, −5), the abscissa (x-coordinate) is 3 and the ordinate (y-coordinate) is −5. Therefore, abscissa − ordinate = 3 − (−5) = 3 + 5 = 8. The other options are incorrect because they result from sign errors in handling the negative ordinate.

questions.text: किसी रेखाखंड का मध्य-बिंदु उस रेखाखंड को जिस अनुपात में विभाजित करता है, वह है :
questions.text_english: The mid-point of a line segment divides the line segment in the ratio :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) 1 : 1. By definition, the mid-point of a line segment is the point that lies exactly at the centre, dividing the segment into two equal halves. Hence the ratio is 1 : 1. A ratio of 1:2 or 2:1 would give a point that divides the segment unequally, and 1/2 : 2 is also unequal.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) 1 : 1 है। मध्य-बिंदु रेखाखंड को दो बराबर भागों में बाँटता है, इसलिए अनुपात 1 : 1 होता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी त्रिभुजों की समरूपता की कसौटी नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not the criterion for similarity of triangles ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) RHS. The criteria for similarity of triangles are AAA (Angle-Angle-Angle), SSS (Side-Side-Side proportionality), and SAS (Side-Angle-Side). RHS (Right angle-Hypotenuse-Side) is a criterion for congruence of right-angled triangles, not for similarity. Therefore RHS does not apply as a similarity test.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) RHS है। त्रिभुजों की समरूपता की कसौटियाँ AAA, SSS और SAS हैं। RHS सर्वांगसमता की कसौटी है, समरूपता की नहीं।

questions.text: नीचे दी गई आकृतियों से, ∠P के माप के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है ?
questions.text_english: From the figures given below, which of the following is true about the measure of ∠P ?

options.D: The measure of ∠P cannot be determined

options_english.D: The measure of ∠P cannot be determined

questions.image_description: Two triangles are shown. Triangle ABC has angle A = 80°, angle B = 60°, side AB = 3.8 cm, side AC = 3√3 cm, side BC = 6 cm. Triangle RPQ has side PR = 6√3 cm, side RQ = 7.6 cm, side PQ = 12 cm. The two triangles appear to be similar.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) ∠P = 80°. Checking the sides of triangle ABC and triangle RPQ: AB/RQ = 3.8/7.6 = 1/2, BC/PQ = 6/12 = 1/2, AC/PR = 3√3/6√3 = 1/2. Since all corresponding sides are in the same ratio, △ABC ~ △RPQ by SSS similarity. Therefore the corresponding angles are equal: ∠A corresponds to ∠R, ∠B corresponds to ∠Q, and ∠C corresponds to ∠P. Since ∠A = 80°, we get ∠P = ∠C = 180° − 80° − 60° = 40°. Wait — ∠C = 180° − 80° − 60° = 40°, so ∠P = 40°. The correct answer is (C) ∠P = 40°.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, केन्द्र O वाले वृत्त पर PA एक स्पर्श-रेखा है। यदि OP = 10 cm है, तो AP की लम्बाई होगी :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PA is a tangent to a circle with centre O. If OP = 10 cm, then the length of AP is :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. PA is a tangent at point A. The angle at P is 30°. OP = 10 cm. OA is the radius perpendicular to PA.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) 5√3 cm. Since PA is a tangent, OA ⊥ PA, so ∠OAP = 90°. In right triangle OAP, the angle at P = 30°. Therefore tan 30° = OA/AP, but more directly: sin 30° = OA/OP = OA/10, so OA = 5 cm (radius). Using cos 30° = AP/OP: AP = OP × cos 30° = 10 × (√3/2) = 5√3 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: PA स्पर्श-रेखा है, अतः OA ⊥ PA। ∠OPА = 30°, OP = 10 cm। cos 30° = AP/OP ⟹ AP = 10 × (√3/2) = 5√3 cm।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन असत्य है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following statements is false ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) sin 30° = cos 30°. sin 30° = 1/2 and cos 30° = √3/2, which are not equal, so this statement is false. Checking the others: tan 45° = 1 = cot 45° (true); sin 90° = 1 = tan 45° (true); sin 45° = 1/√2 = cos 45° (true). Only option C is false.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। sin 30° = 1/2 और cos 30° = √3/2, जो बराबर नहीं हैं। अतः यह कथन असत्य है।

questions.text: (tan²A − 1/cos²A) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of (tan²A − 1/cos²A) is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) −1. We know that tan²A = sin²A/cos²A and 1/cos²A = sec²A. So tan²A − 1/cos²A = tan²A − sec²A. Using the identity sec²A − tan²A = 1, we get tan²A − sec²A = −1. Therefore the value of the expression is −1.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) −1 है। tan²A − 1/cos²A = tan²A − sec²A = −(sec²A − tan²A) = −1।

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कोण अवनमन कोण है ?
questions.text_english: In the given figure, which of the following angles represents the angle of depression ?
questions.image_description: A diagram showing an observer at the top left. A horizontal dashed line is drawn from the observer. Angle z is between the horizontal line and the line of sight going downward to the object. Angle y is below z. Angle a is at the base. Angle x is at the object level.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) z. The angle of depression is the angle formed between the horizontal line drawn at the observer's eye level and the line of sight looking downward toward the object. In the figure, angle z is formed between the horizontal line at the observer and the line of sight directed downward toward the object, making it the angle of depression.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) z है। अवनमन कोण, प्रेक्षक की क्षैतिज रेखा और वस्तु की ओर नीचे देखी गई दृष्टि रेखा के बीच बनता है। आकृति में कोण z यही है।

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में छायांकित क्षेत्र का परिमाप है :
questions.text_english: The perimeter of the shaded region in the given figure is :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. Inside the circle, a triangle is shown with a shaded region. The arc of the circle has length l, the base of the triangle (chord) is a, and the two equal sides of the triangle are each r (the radius). The shaded region is the triangle formed inside the circle with the arc as the curved boundary.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) l + 2r + a. The perimeter of the shaded region consists of the arc length l (curved part), the two radii each of length r forming the sides of the triangle, and the base chord of length a. Therefore the total perimeter = l + r + r + a = l + 2r + a.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) l + 2r + a है। छायांकित क्षेत्र की सीमा में चाप l, दोनों त्रिज्याएँ r+r और आधार a सम्मिलित हैं। अतः परिमाप = l + 2r + a।

questions.text: एक वृत्त के चतुर्थांश (quadrant) के क्षेत्रफल का अनुपात, उसी वृत्त के क्षेत्रफल से होता है :
questions.text_english: The ratio of the area of a quadrant of a circle to the area of the same circle is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) 1 : 4. A quadrant is one-fourth of a circle. Area of a quadrant = (1/4)πr² and area of the full circle = πr². Therefore the ratio = (πr²/4) : πr² = 1 : 4. The other options are incorrect as they either double or quadruple the quadrant area.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) 1 : 4 है। चतुर्थांश का क्षेत्रफल = (1/4)πr²। वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल = πr²। अनुपात = 1 : 4।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किस ठोस का पार्श्वीय/वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल और संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल एक समान है ?
questions.text_english: For which of the following solids is the lateral/curved surface area and total surface area the same ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Sphere. For a sphere, the total surface area = 4πr² and the curved surface area = 4πr². Since a sphere has no flat faces, both are equal. For a cube or cuboid, the lateral surface area excludes the top and bottom faces. For a hemisphere, the curved surface area is 2πr² but the total surface area is 3πr², so they differ.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) गोला है। गोले का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 4πr²। गोले में कोई सपाट फलक नहीं होता।

questions.text_english:
The class mark of the median class of the following data is :
Class Interval: 10–25, 25–40, 40–55, 55–70, 70–85, 85–100
Frequency: 2, 3, 7, 6, 6, 6
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) 47.5. Total frequency = 2+3+7+6+6+6 = 30. n/2 = 15. Cumulative frequencies: 2, 5, 12, 18, ... The cumulative frequency first exceeds 15 in the class 40–55 (cf becomes 12 before this class, and 12+7=19 after). So the median class is 40–55. The class mark = (40+55)/2 = 95/2 = 47.5.

questions.text:
टेस्ट मैचों में कुछ बल्लेबाजों द्वारा बनाए गए रनों की संख्या निम्नलिखित बंटन में दर्शाई गई है :
बनाए गए रनों की संख्या: 3000–4000, 4000–5000, 5000–6000, 6000–7000
बल्लेबाजों की संख्या: 5, 10, 9, 8
बहुलक वर्ग की निचली वर्ग सीमा है :
questions.text_english:
The following distribution shows the number of runs scored by some batsmen in test matches :
Runs Scored: 3000–4000, 4000–5000, 5000–6000, 6000–7000
Number of Batsmen: 5, 10, 9, 8
The lower limit of the modal class is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) 4000. The modal class is the class with the highest frequency. The frequencies are: 5, 10, 9, 8. The highest frequency is 10, which corresponds to the class 4000–5000. Therefore the lower limit of the modal class is 4000.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) 4000 है। सर्वाधिक बारंबारता 10 है, जो वर्ग 4000–5000 से सम्बन्धित है। अतः बहुलक वर्ग की निचली सीमा 4000 है।

questions.text: पासा फेंकने के एक यादृच्छिक प्रयोग में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी घटना निश्चित है ?
questions.text_english: In a random experiment of throwing a die, which of the following is a sure event ?

options.A: 1 से 6 के बीच की संख्या प्राप्त होना
options.B: 7 से कम एक विषम संख्या प्राप्त होना
options.C: 7 से कम एक सम संख्या प्राप्त होना
options.D: 7 से कम एक प्राकृत संख्या प्राप्त होना

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Getting a natural number less than 7. A die has faces numbered 1 to 6, all of which are natural numbers less than 7. So this event will always occur, making it a sure event with probability 1. Option A is incorrect because 'between' usually excludes endpoints. Options B and C are not certain since some outcomes are even and some are odd.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। पासे पर 1 से 6 तक की सभी संख्याएँ 7 से कम प्राकृत संख्याएँ हैं, इसलिए यह घटना सदैव घटित होती है। यह निश्चित घटना है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : किन्हीं दो प्राकृत संख्याओं a और b के लिए, a और b का HCF, a और b के LCM का एक गुणनखंड होता है।
तर्क (R) : किन्हीं दो प्राकृत संख्याओं का HCF, दोनों संख्याओं को विभाजित करता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : For any two natural numbers a and b, the HCF of a and b is a factor of the LCM of a and b.
Reason (R) : HCF of any two natural numbers divides both the numbers.
questions.instruction_line: दोनों कथनों को पढ़कर सही विकल्प चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Assertion A is true: since HCF × LCM = a × b, the HCF divides the LCM (as LCM = ab/HCF, meaning HCF is a factor of LCM). Reason R is also true: by definition, HCF is the greatest common divisor, so it divides both a and b. Moreover, R correctly explains A — because HCF divides both a and b, it also divides their LCM.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अभिकथन A सत्य है क्योंकि HCF × LCM = a × b, अतः HCF, LCM का गुणनखंड है। तर्क R भी सत्य है और A की सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : p का मान, जिसके लिए समीकरण निकाय 4x + py + 8 = 0 और 2x + 2y + 2 = 0 संगत है, 4 है।
तर्क (R) : समीकरण निकाय a₁x + b₁y = c₁ तथा a₂x + b₂y = c₂ संगत है जिसमें अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हल हैं, यदि a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : The value of p for which the system of equations 4x + py + 8 = 0 and 2x + 2y + 2 = 0 is consistent is 4.
Reason (R) : The system of equations a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂ is consistent with infinitely many solutions, if a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂.
questions.instruction_line: दोनों कथनों को पढ़कर सही विकल्प चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). For the system to be consistent with infinitely many solutions: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂, i.e., 4/2 = p/2 = 8/2 → 2 = p/2 = 4. Since p/2 = 2 gives p = 4, but 8/2 = 4 ≠ 2, the ratios are not all equal. So p = 4 does not give infinitely many solutions. However, for the system to be simply consistent (have at least one solution), it need not require all three ratios equal. Checking p = 4: the equations become parallel (4/2 = p/2 = 2, but c ratio = 4 ≠ 2), making them inconsistent. Therefore Assertion A is false. Reason R is true as a standard result. Hence (D).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। p=4 रखने पर 4/2 = p/2 = 2 परन्तु c₁/c₂ = 8/2 = 4 ≠ 2, अतः समीकरण निकाय असंगत होगा। अभिकथन A गलत है। तर्क R सत्य है।
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित समीकरण निकाय को x और y के लिए हल कीजिए :
x/2 + 2y/3 = −1 और x − y/3 = 3
questions.text_english:
Solve the following system of equations for x and y :
x/2 + 2y/3 = −1 and x − y/3 = 3
questions.solution: Multiplying the first equation by 6: 3x + 4y = −6 ... (i). Multiplying the second equation by 3: 3x − y = 9 ... (ii). Subtracting (ii) from (i): 5y = −15, so y = −3. Substituting y = −3 in equation (ii): 3x − (−3) = 9 → 3x = 6 → x = 2. Therefore x = 2 and y = −3.
questions.solution_hindi: पहले समीकरण को 6 से गुणा करने पर: 3x + 4y = −6 ... (i)। दूसरे समीकरण को 3 से गुणा करने पर: 3x − y = 9 ... (ii)। (i) − (ii): 5y = −15, y = −3। (ii) में रखने पर x = 2।

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, यदि PQ ∥ RS है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि △POQ ~ △SOR.
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, if PQ ∥ RS, then prove that △POQ ~ △SOR.
sub_questions.image_description: Two lines PQ and RS are parallel. They are cut by two transversals that meet at point O. P and Q are on one line, R and S are on the other line, with O as the intersection point of the two transversals.
sub_questions.solution: In △POQ and △SOR: ∠POQ = ∠SOR (vertically opposite angles). Since PQ ∥ RS, ∠OPQ = ∠OSR (alternate interior angles, as transversal cuts the parallel lines). Therefore by AA similarity criterion, △POQ ~ △SOR.

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, △OSR ~ △OQP, ∠ROQ = 125° तथा ∠ORS = 70°. ∠OSR और ∠OQP के माप ज्ञात कीजिए।

sub_questions.image_description: Two parallel lines SR and PQ. Two transversals cross at O. Angle ROQ = 125°, angle ORS = 70°.
sub_questions.solution: ∠ROS = 180° − ∠ROQ = 180° − 125° = 55° (angles on a straight line). In △OSR: ∠OSR = 180° − ∠ORS − ∠ROS = 180° − 70° − 55° = 55°. Since △OSR ~ △OQP, corresponding angles are equal. Therefore ∠OQP = ∠OSR = 55°.

questions.text: दो संकेन्द्रीय वृत्तों की त्रिज्याएँ 6 cm और 10 cm हैं। बड़े वृत्त की जीवा, जो छोटे वृत्त को स्पर्श करती है, की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Two concentric circles are of radii 6 cm and 10 cm. Find the length of the chord of the larger circle which touches the smaller circle.
questions.solution: Let O be the common centre. The chord AB of the larger circle (radius 10 cm) is tangent to the smaller circle (radius 6 cm) at point M. Since the chord is tangent to the smaller circle, OM ⊥ AB, so M is the midpoint of AB. In right triangle OMA: OA² = OM² + AM², so 10² = 6² + AM², giving AM² = 100 − 36 = 64, thus AM = 8 cm. Therefore AB = 2 × AM = 16 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: केन्द्र O से जीवा AB पर लम्ब OM खींचें (OM = 6 cm, OA = 10 cm)। OA² = OM² + AM² → AM² = 64 → AM = 8 cm। AB = 2 × 8 = 16 cm।

sub_questions.text: A और B (0 ≤ A < 90°, 0 ≤ B < 90°) के मान ज्ञात कीजिए, यदि tan (A + B) = 1 और tan (A − B) = 1/√3 हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the values of A and B (0 ≤ A < 90°, 0 ≤ B < 90°), if tan (A + B) = 1 and tan (A − B) = 1/√3.
sub_questions.solution: tan (A + B) = 1 = tan 45°, so A + B = 45°. tan (A − B) = 1/√3 = tan 30°, so A − B = 30°. Adding: 2A = 75°, thus A = 37.5°. Subtracting: 2B = 15°, thus B = 7.5°.

sub_questions.text: ज्यामितीय विधि से सिद्ध कीजिए कि tan 45° = 1.
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that tan 45° = 1 geometrically.

key_points: In an isosceles right triangle with angles 45°-45°-90°

sub_questions.solution: Consider a right-angled triangle ABC with ∠B = 90° and ∠A = ∠C = 45°. Since two angles are equal (45°), the triangle is isosceles, making the two legs equal: BC = AB. Therefore tan 45° = opposite/adjacent = BC/AB = 1. Hence tan 45° = 1 is proved geometrically.

questions.text: 20 cm व्यास वाले वृत्त की एक जीवा वृत्त के केन्द्र पर 60° का कोण बनाती है। वृत्त के संगत लघु वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए। (π = 3.14 और √3 = 1.73 प्रयोग कीजिए)
questions.text_english: A chord of a circle of diameter 20 cm subtends an angle of 60° at the centre of the circle. Find the area of the corresponding minor segment of the circle. (Use π = 3.14 and √3 = 1.73)
questions.solution: Radius r = 10 cm, angle θ = 60°. Area of minor sector = (θ/360°) × πr² = (60/360) × 3.14 × 100 = (1/6) × 314 = 52.33 cm². Area of triangle = (1/2) × r² × sin 60° = (1/2) × 100 × (√3/2) = 25√3 = 25 × 1.73 = 43.25 cm². Area of minor segment = 52.33 − 43.25 = 9.08 cm² (approximately).

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि √3 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that √3 is an irrational number.

key_points: Show that 3 divides both p and q contradicting co-prime assumption

sub_questions.solution: Assume √3 is rational. Then √3 = p/q where p and q are integers with no common factor (co-prime) and q ≠ 0. Squaring both sides: 3 = p²/q², so p² = 3q². This means 3 divides p², and since 3 is prime, 3 also divides p. Let p = 3m. Then (3m)² = 3q², giving 9m² = 3q², so q² = 3m², meaning 3 divides q. But then 3 divides both p and q, contradicting the assumption that p and q are co-prime. Therefore √3 is irrational.

sub_questions.text: संख्या x का गुणनखंड वृक्ष नीचे दिखाया गया है। x, y, a और b के मान ज्ञात कीजिए। अतः संख्या x को अभाज्य गुणनखंडों के गुणनफल के रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The factor tree of a number x is shown below. Find the values of x, y, a and b. Hence, write the product of the prime factors of the number x so obtained.
sub_questions.image_description: A factor tree: x splits into 2 and y. y splits into 2 and 210. 210 splits into a and 70. 70 splits into 2 and 35. 35 splits into 5 and b.

questions.text: एक द्विघात बहुपद ज्ञात कीजिए जिसमें इसके शून्यकों का योगफल तथा गुणनफल क्रमशः 0 और −9 हों। प्राप्त बहुपद के शून्यक भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find a quadratic polynomial whose sum and product of zeroes are 0 and −9, respectively. Also, find the zeroes of the polynomial so obtained.
questions.solution: A quadratic polynomial with sum of zeroes = α + β and product of zeroes = αβ is given by p(x) = x² − (α + β)x + αβ. Here, α + β = 0 and αβ = −9. So p(x) = x² − 0·x + (−9) = x² − 9. To find zeroes: x² − 9 = 0 → x² = 9 → x = ±3. Therefore the zeroes are 3 and −3.
questions.solution_hindi: द्विघात बहुपद = x² − (शून्यकों का योग)x + (शून्यकों का गुणनफल) = x² − 0 − 9 = x² − 9। शून्यक: x² = 9 → x = ±3।

sub_questions.text:
निम्नलिखित समीकरण निकाय को आलेख विधि से हल कीजिए :
x + 3y = 6; 2x − 3y = 12
sub_questions.text_english:
Solve the following system of equations graphically :
x + 3y = 6; 2x − 3y = 12
sub_questions.solution: For x + 3y = 6: when x = 0, y = 2 (point (0,2)); when y = 0, x = 6 (point (6,0)). For 2x − 3y = 12: when x = 0, y = −4 (point (0,−4)); when y = 0, x = 6 (point (6,0)). Plotting both lines, they intersect at (6, 0). Therefore the solution is x = 6 and y = 0.

sub_questions.text: x और y दो इस प्रकार के पूरक कोण हैं कि x : y = 1 : 2. दी गई सूचना को दो चरों वाले एक रैखिक समीकरण निकाय के रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए और तत्पश्चात् इसे हल कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: x and y are complementary angles such that x : y = 1 : 2. Express the given information as a system of linear equations in two variables and hence solve it.
sub_questions.solution: Complementary angles sum to 90°, so x + y = 90° ... (i). Given x : y = 1 : 2, we can write 2x = y, i.e., 2x − y = 0 ... (ii). Adding (i) and (ii): 3x = 90°, so x = 30°. From (i): y = 90° − 30° = 60°. Therefore x = 30° and y = 60°.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि वृत्त के परिगत बना आयत एक वर्ग होता है।
questions.text_english: Prove that a rectangle circumscribing a circle is a square.

key_points: Tangents from an external point are equal
All sides of the rectangle are equal

questions.solution: Let ABCD be a rectangle circumscribing a circle. Let the circle touch the sides AB, BC, CD and DA at P, Q, R and S respectively. Since tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal in length: from A: AP = AS, from B: BP = BQ, from C: CQ = CR, from D: DR = DS. Now AB = AP + PB, CD = CR + RD = CQ + DS. Also BC = BQ + QC and AD = AS + SD. Since ABCD is a rectangle, AB = CD and BC = AD. Adding all tangent equalities: AP + BQ + CR + DS = AS + BP + CQ + DR. This gives AB + CD = BC + AD, i.e., 2AB = 2BC, so AB = BC. Since all angles of a rectangle are 90° and now all sides are equal, ABCD is a square.
questions.solution_hindi: माना ABCD एक आयत है जो वृत्त के परिगत है। बाह्य बिंदु से खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखाएँ समान होती हैं। तदनुसार AB = BC सिद्ध होता है। अतः सभी भुजाएँ बराबर होने पर आयत वर्ग बन जाता है।

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि : (1 + cot²A)/(1 + tan²A) = ((1 − cotA)/(1 − tanA))²
questions.text_english: Prove that : (1 + cot²A)/(1 + tan²A) = ((1 − cotA)/(1 − tanA))²

key_points: Use cosec²A = 1 + cot²A and sec²A = 1 + tan²A

questions.solution: LHS = (1 + cot²A)/(1 + tan²A) = cosec²A/sec²A = (1/sin²A)/(1/cos²A) = cos²A/sin²A = cot²A. RHS = ((1 − cotA)/(1 − tanA))². Writing cotA = cosA/sinA and tanA = sinA/cosA: (1 − cosA/sinA)/(1 − sinA/cosA) = ((sinA − cosA)/sinA)/((cosA − sinA)/cosA) = [−(cosA − sinA)/sinA] × [cosA/(cosA − sinA)] = −cosA/sinA. Squaring: (−cosA/sinA)² = cos²A/sin²A = cot²A. Therefore LHS = RHS = cot²A. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: LHS = cosec²A/sec²A = cos²A/sin²A = cot²A। RHS = ((1−cotA)/(1−tanA))² = cot²A। अतः LHS = RHS।

questions.text: 200 पेनों के एक समूह में 180 पेन अच्छे हैं और बाकी के पेन खराब हैं। एक ग्राहक पेन जब ही खरीदता है जब वह खराब न हो। दुकानदार एक पेन इस समूह से यादृच्छया निकालता है और ग्राहक को देता है। ग्राहक इस पेन को नहीं खरीदेगा, इसकी प्रायिकता क्या है? 100 पेनों का एक और समूह है जिसमें 80 पेन अच्छे हैं, उसको 200 पेनों के पहले वाले समूह में मिला दिया जाता है। तत्पश्चात् दुकानदार अब पूरे समूह से एक पेन यादृच्छया निकालता है और इस पेन को ग्राहक को देता है। ग्राहक इस पेन को खरीदेगा, इसकी प्रायिकता क्या है?
questions.text_english: A lot consists of 200 pens of which 180 are good and the rest are defective. A customer will buy a pen if it is not defective. The shopkeeper draws a pen at random and gives it to the customer. What is the probability that the customer will not buy it? Another lot of 100 pens containing 80 good pens is mixed with the previous lot of 200 pens. The shopkeeper now draws one pen at random from the entire lot and gives it to the customer. What is the probability that the customer will buy the pen?

key_points: P(customer will buy from combined lot) = 260/300 = 13/15

questions.solution: In the first lot: defective pens = 200 − 180 = 20. P(customer will not buy) = P(defective) = 20/200 = 1/10. After mixing: total pens = 200 + 100 = 300. Good pens = 180 + 80 = 260. P(customer will buy) = 260/300 = 13/15.

sub_questions.text: दो धनात्मक संख्याओं के वर्गों का अन्तर 180 है। छोटी संख्या का वर्ग, बड़ी संख्या का 8 गुना है। दोनों संख्याएँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The difference of the squares of two positive numbers is 180. The square of the smaller number is 8 times the greater number. Find the two numbers.
sub_questions.solution: Let the greater number be x and the smaller number be y. Given: x² − y² = 180 ... (i) and y² = 8x ... (ii). Substituting (ii) in (i): x² − 8x = 180 → x² − 8x − 180 = 0 → x² − 18x + 10x − 180 = 0 → x(x − 18) + 10(x − 18) = 0 → (x + 10)(x − 18) = 0. Since x is positive, x = 18. From (ii): y² = 8 × 18 = 144, so y = 12. The two numbers are 18 and 12.

sub_questions.text: k का/के मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके/जिनके लिए समीकरण 2x² + kx + 3 = 0 के वास्तविक और बराबर मूल हों। इस प्रकार प्राप्त हुए समीकरण के मूल भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the value(s) of k for which the equation 2x² + kx + 3 = 0 has real and equal roots. Hence, find the roots of the equations so obtained.

key_points: Roots: −√6/2 each (for k = 2√6) and √6/2 each (for k = −2√6)

sub_questions.solution: For real and equal roots, the discriminant D = 0. D = b² − 4ac = k² − 4(2)(3) = k² − 24 = 0. Therefore k² = 24, so k = ±2√6. For k = 2√6: the equation is 2x² + 2√6 x + 3 = 0. The root = −b/2a = −2√6/4 = −√6/2 (equal roots). For k = −2√6: the equation is 2x² − 2√6 x + 3 = 0. The root = 2√6/4 = √6/2 (equal roots).

questions.text: "आधारभूत समानुपातिकता प्रमेय" को लिखिए और इसका प्रयोग करके निम्नलिखित को सिद्ध कीजिए : एक चतुर्भुज ABCD में, विकर्ण AC और BD परस्पर एक-दूसरे को O पर इस प्रकार प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं कि AO/BO = CO/DO जैसा दी गई आकृति में दिखाया गया है। सिद्ध कीजिए कि ABCD एक समलम्ब है।
questions.text_english: State 'Basic Proportionality Theorem' and use it to prove the following : In a quadrilateral ABCD, diagonals AC and BD intersect each other at O such that AO/BO = CO/DO as shown in the given figure. Prove that ABCD is a trapezium.

key_points: Draw a line through D parallel to AC
Use converse of BPT to show DC ∥ AB

questions.image_description: Quadrilateral ABCD with diagonals AC and BD intersecting at O. The figure shows a trapezium shape.
questions.solution: Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT): If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle, then it divides the other two sides proportionally. Given: In quadrilateral ABCD, AO/BO = CO/DO. Draw a line DE through D parallel to AB, meeting AC at E. In △ABD, since DE ∥ AB, by BPT: OE/OA = DO/OB. But given AO/BO = CO/DO, i.e., OA/OB = OC/OD. Comparing: OE/OA = OC/OA, so OE = OC, meaning E coincides with C. Therefore DE passes through C, meaning DC ∥ AB (as DE ∥ AB). Since one pair of opposite sides (DC and AB) is parallel, ABCD is a trapezium.
questions.solution_hindi: BPT: यदि किसी त्रिभुज की एक भुजा के समान्तर रेखा खींची जाए तो वह अन्य दो भुजाओं को समानुपात में विभाजित करती है। दिया है AO/BO = CO/DO। D से AB के समान्तर रेखा DE खींचें। BPT के विलोम से DC ∥ AB सिद्ध होता है। अतः ABCD समलम्ब है।

sub_questions.text: एक खिलौना एक अर्धगोले पर खड़े एक शंकु के आकार का है। शंकु और अर्धगोले की त्रिज्याएँ बराबर हैं। खिलौने के शंकुकार भाग की ऊँचाई उसके आधार के व्यास के बराबर है। यदि शंकुकार भाग की त्रिज्या 5 cm है, तो खिलौने का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: A toy is in the form of a cone surmounted on a hemisphere. The cone and hemisphere have the same radii. The height of the conical part of the toy is equal to the diameter of its base. If the radius of the conical part is 5 cm, find the volume of the toy.
sub_questions.solution: Radius of cone = radius of hemisphere = r = 5 cm. Height of cone h = diameter = 2r = 10 cm. Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3) × π × 25 × 10 = 250π/3 cm³. Volume of hemisphere = (2/3)πr³ = (2/3) × π × 125 = 250π/3 cm³. Total volume = 250π/3 + 250π/3 = 500π/3 = 500 × 22/(3 × 7) = 11000/21 ≈ 523.8 cm³.

sub_questions.text: एक घनाकार ब्लॉक के ऊपर 3.5 cm त्रिज्या का एक अर्धगोला रखा गया है। घन के किनारे की न्यूनतम संभव लम्बाई क्या है, ताकि गोलार्ध पूरी तरह से घन पर स्थित हो सके? इस प्रकार बने ठोस का संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: A cubical block is surmounted by a hemisphere of radius 3.5 cm. What is the smallest possible length of the edge of the cube so that the hemisphere can totally lie on the cube? Find the total surface area of the solid so formed.
sub_questions.solution: The hemisphere must completely lie on the cube, so the minimum edge of the cube = diameter of hemisphere = 2 × 3.5 = 7 cm. Total surface area of solid = TSA of cube − base area of hemisphere + curved surface area of hemisphere = 6a² − πr² + 2πr² = 6(7)² + πr² = 6 × 49 + (22/7) × (3.5)² = 294 + (22/7) × 12.25 = 294 + 38.5 = 332.5 cm².

questions.solution: This question has two options — answer either part (a) or part (b). Solutions are provided in sub-questions.

questions.text: एक इमारत की छत पर एक घायल पक्षी दिखाई देता है। यह इमारत 15 m ऊँची है। पक्षी को बचाने के उद्देश्य से, एक फायरमैन को बुलाया जाता है। फायरमैन ने छत तक पहुँचने के लिए एक समायोज्य सीढ़ी का उपयोग किया। उसने सीढ़ी को इस प्रकार रखा कि छत तक पहुँचने के लिए सीढ़ी भूमि से 60° का कोण बनाए।
questions.text_english: An injured bird was found on the roof of a building. The building is 15 m high. A fireman was called to rescue the bird. The fireman used an adjustable ladder to reach the roof. He placed the ladder in such a way that the ladder makes an angle of 60° with the ground in order to reach the roof.
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: सीढ़ी की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए, जिसे फायरमैन ने छत पर पहुँचने के लिए उपयोग किया था।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the length of the ladder used by the fireman to reach the roof.
sub_questions.solution: The building height = 15 m, angle with ground = 60°. sin 60° = height/ladder length → √3/2 = 15/L → L = 15 × 2/√3 = 30/√3 = 10√3 m.

sub_questions.text: इमारत के पाद से भूमि पर उस बिन्दु की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए, जहाँ सीढ़ी को रखा गया था।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the distance of the point on the ground at which the ladder was fixed from the bottom of the building.
sub_questions.solution: tan 60° = height/base → √3 = 15/d → d = 15/√3 = 5√3 m.

sub_questions.text_english: In order to avoid skidding, the fireman placed the ladder in such a way that the bottom of the ladder touches the base of the wall which is opposite to the building, making an angle of 30° with the ground.
sub_questions.solution: This part has two options.

sub_sub_questions.text_english: (a) Draw a neat diagram to represent the above situation and hence find the width of the road between the building and the wall.
sub_sub_questions.solution: In the new scenario, the ladder leans against the opposite wall at 30° to the ground. The top of the ladder reaches the building roof at height 15 m (using the same ladder of length 10√3 m). tan 30° = 15/width → 1/√3 = 15/w → w = 15√3 m. The width of the road = 15√3 m.

sub_sub_questions.text_english: (b) Find the length of the ladder used by the fireman in this case.
sub_sub_questions.solution: sin 30° = height/ladder → 1/2 = 15/L → L = 30 m. The length of the ladder used by the fireman in this case is 30 m.

questions.image_description: A building of height 15 m with a fireman using a ladder. The ladder makes a 60° angle with the ground. A fireman and a bird on the roof are shown.
questions.solution: Case study on heights and distances. Individual answers are in sub-questions.

questions.text: एक बगीचे में, सर्पिल पैटर्न बनाने के लिए गुलाब के फूलों के पौधे समान अंतराल पर लगाए गए थे। सर्पिल क्रमिक अर्धवृत्तों से बना है, जिसका केन्द्र वैकल्पिक रूप से A और B पर है, जो त्रिज्याओं 50 cm, 100 cm, 150 cm, ....... के केन्द्र A से शुरू होता है। सर्पिल 1 में 10 फूल, सर्पिल 2 में 20 फूल, सर्पिल 3 में 30 फूल और इसी तरह।
questions.text_english: In a garden, saplings of rose flowers were planted at equal intervals to form a spiral pattern. The spiral is made up of successive semicircles, with centres alternatively at A and B, starting with centre at A, of radii 50 cm, 100 cm, 150 cm, ....... as shown in the figure given below. Spiral 1 has 10 flowers, Spiral 2 has 20 flowers, Spiral 3 has 30 flowers and so on.
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text_english: What is the radius of the 13th spiral ?
sub_questions.solution: The radii form an AP: 50, 100, 150, ... with first term a = 50 and common difference d = 50. The nth term = a + (n−1)d = 50 + (n−1) × 50 = 50n. For n = 13: radius = 50 × 13 = 650 cm.

sub_questions.text: यदि nवीं सर्पिल की त्रिज्या 500 cm है, तो n का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If the radius of the nth spiral is 500 cm, find the value of n.
sub_questions.solution: The nth radius = 50n = 500, so n = 500/50 = 10.

sub_questions.text_english: Answer either (a) or (b):
sub_questions.solution: This part has two options.

sub_sub_questions.text_english: (a) Find the total number of saplings till the 11th spiral.
sub_sub_questions.solution: Number of flowers in each spiral: 10, 20, 30, ... This is an AP with a = 10 and d = 10. Sum till 11th spiral = S₁₁ = (11/2)(2 × 10 + 10 × 10) = (11/2)(20 + 100) = (11/2)(120) = 11 × 60 = 660 saplings.

sub_sub_questions.text_english: (b) Till which spiral, will there be a total of 450 saplings?
sub_sub_questions.solution: Sₙ = (n/2)(2 × 10 + (n−1) × 10) = (n/2)(10n + 10) = 5n(n + 1) = 450. So n(n+1) = 90. Testing n = 9: 9 × 10 = 90. Therefore till the 9th spiral, there will be a total of 450 saplings.

questions.image_description: A spiral pattern formed by successive semicircles with centres alternately at A and B. Radii l1, l2, l3, l4 represent the successive semicircles.
questions.solution: Case study on Arithmetic Progressions. Individual answers are in sub-questions.

questions.text: एक सोसाइटी में एक वृत्ताकार पार्क है जिसके दो गेट हैं। ये दोनों गेट बिन्दु A(10, 20) और B(50, 50) पर लगे हैं। दो फव्वारे बिन्दु P और Q, जो रेखाखंड AB पर स्थित हैं, इस तरह लगाए गए हैं कि AP = PQ = QB.
questions.text_english: In a society, there is a circular park having two gates. The gates are placed at points A(10, 20) and B(50, 50), as shown in the figure below. Two fountains are installed at points P and Q on AB such that AP = PQ = QB.
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: केन्द्र C के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the coordinates of the centre C.
sub_questions.solution: The centre C is the midpoint of AB (since AB is the diameter of the circular park). C = ((10+50)/2, (20+50)/2) = (60/2, 70/2) = (30, 35).

sub_questions.text: वृत्ताकार पार्क की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the radius of the circular park.
sub_questions.solution: Radius = distance from centre C(30,35) to gate A(10,20) = √((30−10)² + (35−20)²) = √(400 + 225) = √625 = 25 units.

sub_questions.text_english: Answer either (a) or (b):
sub_questions.solution: This part has two options.

sub_sub_questions.text_english: (a) Find the coordinates of the point P.
(b) Find the distance of the fountain at Q from gate A.

questions.image_description: A circular park with two gates A(10,20) and B(50,50). Two fountains P and Q are on AB with AP=PQ=QB. Centre C is the midpoint of AB.
questions.solution: Case study on Coordinate Geometry. Individual answers are in sub-questions.
